assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness

The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I25.10 is assigned
The diagnosis code I34.0 is assigned
There is a need to evaluate for potential arrhythmias contributing to hemodynamic instability
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to correlate clinical events with cardiac rhythm disturbances

The CPT code 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The claim for CPT code 93247 has been denied
